test_policy.notes: The international freshman page asks for SAT/ACT only from applicants whose native language is English (480 EBRW + 440 Math, or ACT 17 English or 17 Reading and 17 Math, only for those within 5 years of high school with under 30 college credits); applicants whose native language is not English prove English proficiency instead. The page says the test requirement is waived with a 3.0 in the required high school curriculum 'through Summer 2024', so it may be out of date. CDS C8A (2024-2025) lists SAT/ACT as 'required for some'.

requirements.notes: Undergraduate application with a $40 non-refundable fee. Non-US high school transcripts need a professional evaluation (NACES/AICE, WES, IEE or TEC) with a document-by-document review and GPA calculation. I-20 only after full admission plus a financial guarantee form, bank statement and passport copy. The CDS shows 99% of applicants admitted (3,617 of 3,651). Platform is Columbus State's own application; Common App was not checked.

deadlines.label: International freshman application deadline - fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Page prints 'June 1' with no year; taken as fall 2027. Spring term deadline Nov 1; summer term deadline is March 1 on the freshmen page but May 1 on the FAQ page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants whose native language is English need not submit proof of English proficiency but must meet the SAT/ACT requirement. Alternatives accepted instead of TOEFL/IELTS: SAT EBRW 480, ACT English or Reading 17, MET 59, EIKEN Pre-1, Cambridge IGCSE/O-Level English D or better, UK GCSE or GCE A-Level English C or better, Edexcel English D or better. TOEFL Essentials not accepted. Duolingo is no longer accepted.

english.notes: Includes Home Edition and MyBest; paper edition also listed. TOEFL Essentials not accepted. The page does not give a 1-6 band score for the new TOEFL.
Overall band score; IELTS Indicator scores were accepted through December 2023.
Page says the university no longer accepts Duolingo scores.

aid.notes: The FAQ says F-1 students can apply for 'a limited number of service scholarships' through the Center for Global Engagement; no amounts are published. The scholarships page does not say whether international students qualify for institutional awards, and CDS H6 (nonresident aid policy) was unreadable. Conditional admission is available: students with insufficient English enroll in the English Language Institute until they meet the TOEFL minimum (up to three semesters). Health insurance is required and billed with tuition and fees.
